narr: A hot and moist airmass was firmly in place across Southern New Hampshire on July 12th. Overall instability was limited but terrain driven thunderstorms did develop around Mount Monadnock and trained over this region. Localized road damage due flash flooding was reported.
ev: Very heavy rain occurred with 2 to 3 estimated to have fallen in around 1 hour. Excessive run-off caused culverts to become overwhelmed with road damage and flooding being reported at Stoddard Rd, Depot Rd, and Rt. 123 in Hancock.
lsr: Washout on Stoddard Road in Hancock.
NH Rt 123 and Main St in Hancock closed due to road wash out from flooding.
